screen_geography.axis_convention: +x is picture-right when looking from the doorway at the locker (the malkhana_locker_wall master view). In the reverse view (from the locker looking at the doorway) +x is picture-left.
screen_geography.room: Malkhana of the fictional Jalebiganj thana, about 3 m wide, windowless. Locker centred on the back wall; single doorway centred in the opposite wall.

fixed_positions.locker: back wall, centre. Door hinged on its +x side, standing wide open towards +x. Four bare steel shelves.
fixed_positions.brass_padlock: hangs open on a steel staple on the -x edge of the locker frame, chest height
fixed_positions.steel_rack_of_tagged_bundles: -x of the locker (the chai glass is set down here in b03)
fixed_positions.desk_with_ledger_and_phone: against the +x side wall, between the locker and the doorway
fixed_positions.corridor_bulb: beyond the doorway; source of the warm tungsten light

screen_geography.character_sides: From b03 to b06 Meenu stands on the -x side (padlock side) and Bablu on the +x side (trunk and desk side). In the reverse view this puts Bablu and his torch on picture-left; in the master view on picture-right. s02, s03, s05, s06 and s07 all follow this. s04 does not (see shot_check.problems).

time.time_of_day: Night, about 2 a.m. (stated in s02 prompt and the logline).
time.deadline_set_in_scene: DSP inspection at 9 a.m. the same morning, about seven hours away (l07).

characters.name: Sub-Inspector Meenakshi 'Meenu' Rawat
characters.wardrobe: style.json characters[meenu].wardrobe_lock, verbatim, unchanged for the whole scene: khaki shirt, sleeves rolled to just below the elbow, teal epaulettes with two white bars, lantern sleeve patches, khaki trousers, black belt, black shoes, steel-strap watch with blank white dial on her LEFT wrist. No cap, no name tag, no jewellery.

props_carried_at_start: cutting-chai glass, half full, in her RIGHT hand
key ring with exactly one long brass key, in her trouser pocket (not visible)

characters.name: Constable Bablu Tiwari
characters.wardrobe: style.json characters[bablu].wardrobe_lock, verbatim, unchanged for the whole scene: khaki shirt with sleeves buttoned at the wrist, plain teal epaulettes, lantern sleeve patches, maroon sleeveless V-neck sweater-vest, grey muffler with one end on his chest, khaki trousers. No cap, no glasses.
characters.fixed_marks: salt-and-pepper handlebar moustache with upturned tips, receding hairline, pot belly; about 155 cm (top of head reaches Meenu's chin)
characters.injuries: none (a single drop of sweat on his temple in s01 is a look, not a mark that has to carry over)
props_carried_at_start: chunky yellow plastic torch, switched ON, in his RIGHT hand (always)

props.state: On from the first frame (torch click in b01). Always in Bablu's right hand. Aimed: into the locker (b01), at Meenu (b02), at the laddoo, with Meenu steering his hand (b03), up at the ceiling fan (b04), at the padlock (b05), at Meenu's open palm (b06), lowered with the beam out of frame (b08).

In her right hand, stopped halfway to her mouth (b01 silhouette, b02). Set down on the steel rack to the -x side of the locker at the start of b03 (heard as a clink, not seen). Never seen in her hand again; must not appear on any locker shelf.
In her trouser pocket b01 to b05 (not visible). Drawn out in b06 and held flat on her open right palm. Clenched in her right fist, bow showing, in b08. It is the only key on the ring.
Already hanging open and undamaged from the staple when the scene starts; the door is already open. Meenu lifts and turns it with her left hand in b05. Not scratched, dented or forced.

One orange motichoor laddoo with two pistachio slivers on a small off-white fluted paper plate, alone in the centre of the locker's middle shelf (read as the second shelf from the top of four), where the cash bundles were. Nobody touches it during the scene.
Absent. Twenty lakh in seized cash was in the locker; only paler dust-free rectangles on the shelf show where the bundles stood.

Meenu's own phone, lying face up on the desk beside the ledger from before the scene starts (she left it there when she went for chai). Buzzes from b07 to the cut to black. Screen: blue incoming-call screen, contact photo of a heavy-set man in gold-rimmed aviators, blank name band (the name is an assembly overlay). Not answered, not touched.
Closed maroon ledger with a black ballpoint pen on the desk; untouched.

facts_established_for_later_use: Jalebiganj thana, fictional force; emblem a white hurricane lantern on a teal patch.
Meenu is a Sub-Inspector (two bars), on night duty; Bablu is a constable (no bars) and calls her 'madam'; she calls him 'Bablu'.
The malkhana locker held twenty lakh in seized cash. It was emptied, a motichoor laddoo left in its place.
The padlock was opened with a key, not forced. Only two keys exist: Meenu's (still on her ring) and Bada Sahab's.
Bada Sahab is senior to Meenu, is said to be on leave, and his look is fixed by the contact photo (see b07).
A DSP inspection is due at 9 a.m. that morning.
Meenu left her phone on the malkhana desk while she went for chai.
unanswered_at_end: Why is Bada Sahab, on leave and the only other key-holder, calling at 2 a.m. the minute the empty locker is found, and will Meenu pick up? (matches script ending_question)

problems.issue: s04 is drawn from the locker side (reverse view), where Bablu and the doorway-offset both fall on picture-LEFT (s02 puts Bablu lower-left in the same reverse view, and s03, s05, s06 and s07 put him and the torch on the +x side). s04's prompt puts the torch at 'the lower right' and the doorway 'past her shoulder on the right side of the picture' with the warm rim on that side, which mirrors the room. Her gaze to the lower left (towards the laddoo) is already correct.
problems.suggested_edit: In s04's prompt, change 'from a torch held out of the picture at the lower right' to 'at the lower left', and 'small past her shoulder on the right side of the picture, part of the open doorway' to 'on the left side of the picture'. Leave the mole and strand sentences as they are. Not applied: it changes the shot description, which is S7's to change.

problems.issue: The desk with the phone stands against the +x wall (Bablu's side), but Meenu spends b05 and b06 at the -x edge of the locker. In s09 she is lit from below by the phone and looks down at it, so she must have moved to the desk during the 2.5 s s08 insert. This is never shown. In a flat 2D close-up it will not read as an error, so the ledger records the move as off-screen.

Meenu's doorway silhouette in s01 has no chai glass, but in s02 (the next cut) she is holding the glass halfway to her mouth. Optional: add 'one hand raised near her chin holding a small glass' to the silhouette sentence. s02's 'has just stepped into the doorway' is also slightly at odds with s01 showing her already standing there; harmless in a still.

The b03 opening action in the script (two-shot: Meenu crosses, sets the chai glass down, steers Bablu's torch hand) is not given its own shot. It is carried by the cut, the 1.0 s silence and the clink. Acceptable; noted so S11 places the clink at the head of s03.
